description.text: The complete supplied opening image holds at the start: a black sports car with a carbon fibre body rests on an empty showroom floor. The room's light recedes around it, leaving the surrounding space dark while a thin rim of light traces the car's edges and the polished floor beneath it. The car remains stationary as the glow narrows to that faint outline; reflections stretch across the floor, and the bodywork keeps its deep black sheen. The showroom reads as still and uncluttered, with no other vehicles or people in view. A soft electrical hum and a single click suggest the car waking, but nothing moves yet. The frame preserves the full supplied composition, including the car's position, the falloff of light into darkness, and the clean showroom floor. The scene holds on this quiet moment long enough for the darkness to settle around the car before the cut.

The supplied opening frame holds: a black sports car with a carbon fibre body rests on an empty showroom floor, the room's light receding around it until only a thin rim catches the body edges and the polished floor.
A faint electrical hum sits under a soft click as the car wakes.
The showroom light continues to sink into darkness around the stationary car.
The camera holds a static shot.

At the cut, the black sports car pulls forward out of the darkness. Its headlights cut twin cones through the gloom, and the carbon fibre body rolls across the polished floor toward the camera. The engine note rises as the car clears the deepest shadow, tyres gripping the smooth showroom surface. Light gathers along the car's edges and sweeps over the floor as it advances, making the black bodywork glint. The surrounding showroom stays dark and empty, so the movement is the only change in the scene. The car continues toward the viewer, breaking fully out of the dark by the end of the shot, with the floor reflections trailing beneath it and the headlights widening through the remaining haze.
